about_the_game:
This demo includes a preview of the first 3 levels of game and leaderboards to compete on.  Upon completing the demo, the Play+ mode unlocks for all demo content, providing a harder challenge for advanced players!  The full release includes additional game modes and all 9 mesmerizing levels across 27 stages.

From the artist & composer behind the cult hit THUMPER comes THRASHER, a mind-melting arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience. Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds. Race to evolve the space eel from a tiny worm into a mega beast, taking on wild bosses through 9 psychedelic realms. Dive into the game's deep combo system to perfect your runs and compete on the leaderboards, or simply vibe out inside the breathtaking but unsettling landscapes.  Experience the award-winning game on PCVR and 2D screens (including Steam Deck) soon!

TRANSCEND SPACETIME

Immerse yourself in a dazzling odyssey where music, visuals, and gameplay mesh into one transcendent experience. Journey from the depths of primordial gloom to the heights of celestial bliss, culminating in a heart pounding reckoning with a cosmic baby god.

YOU V THE UNIVERSE

Swoop, dash and thrash at breakneck speed, busting through obstacles and stacking up combos, leading to nine jaw dropping encounters with mysterious leviathans that will challenge your skills, and your sanity.

SOUND AND FURY

Lose yourself in the enthralling soundtrack created by designer Brian Gibson, bassist for the band Lightning Bolt. THRASHER is a spatial audio and haptics showcase, creating a stunning sensory experience.

CHILL OR CHALLENGE

Vibe out and enjoy the wild journey, or push yourself to the limit by chaining together massive combos to worm your way up the rankings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR

short_description: THRASHER is an award-winning arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience. Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds in the ultimate race for survival. Get ready to stack up those combos, the game is coming soon to both PCVR and 2D screens!
